details.completeness_justification: K1, K2, K3, K6, K7, K8 and K9 are fully represented. K5 is only partially covered because the candidate provides segment revenue figures but does not state the required percentage mix (43 % cheese/dairy, 28 % dry milk, 15 % fresh milk, 14 % canned milk). K4 is entirely absent: the candidate never mentions the new Baltic Dairy Board SIA factory in Bauska or its 18 kt annual cheese production target.
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is internally coherent. Revenue growth is consistently described across S1–S6, with segment-level detail in S3–S5 logically supporting the consolidated figure in S2. Profitability metrics are presented without contradiction: EBITDA decline (S8) is explicitly distinguished from the net-profit increase (S10), and the exclusion of negative goodwill from EBITDA is clearly stated in S9. Balance-sheet changes (S14–S17) follow logically from the acquisition activity mentioned in S4 and S13. Cash-flow movements (S18–S19) align with the same acquisition and financing events. No self-contradictions, logical gaps, organizational disarray, or unnecessary repetition are present.
